title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
description: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
description: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
description: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
description: Palantir's U.S. commercial revenue surpassed U.S. government revenue for the first time ever.

title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
description: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.

title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
description: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
description: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.

title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
description: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
description: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

title: The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on November 4
description: On November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 brings founders and VCs to Boston's SoWa Power Station for practical insights and connections. Register before prices increase at the door.

title: Tomorrow: TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston and when pass rates increase
description: Secure your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass savings before prices increase tomorrow at 9 a.m. ET. Save up to $100 on your pass, and get a second for free.

title: Apple Watch’s AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing
description: Now in beta: Apple's new Audio Intelligence features can help you remember what someone said or take notes on conversations.

title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
description: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.

title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
description: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
description: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
description: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
description: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?
